<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This forces manual handling of letters and causes significant delays in claim processing.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Thistlecombe Mutual, where supplier letters are not triggering automatically and task assignments are being delayed [i:127684fae8dcc625].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty, which reports that some policyholders are not receiving automated letters and that tasks are not auto-assigned when letters go out [i:69b502589e4937ca] [i:928f645054451436].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, which is handling correspondence manually and wants letters generated automatically based on claim status [i:bd374de2573473a9].\n- Elderfold Home, which has tried to automate letters and hit a wall with the current defaults [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].\n\nAcross these 4 accounts there are 5 mentions, all on the letters go out to policyholders, and reports delays [i:928f645054451436].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (2400000.0 GBP ARR, renewal 2027-01-15) asks whether letters can be generated automatically based on claim status, describing manual correspondence as overwhelming [i:bd374de2573473a9].\n- Elderfold Home (170000.0 GBP ARR, renewal 2026-12-21) has been trying to automate those letters and hit a wall with the current defaults [i:ccd44b8a2420af4b].\n- All 5 mentions across the 4 accounts came through the sales route, and 2 renewals fall within 90 days [i:127684fae8dcc625]
